description: Lists all seven packages (Lava, Vindex, Magma, OMS, Reseller, Franchise, Tycoon) in one response, each with its id, name, one-line summary, price, number of seats where limited, and page URL, plus the disclaimers. Use it to compare packages or to find a package id; use get_package when only one package is needed. Takes no arguments.
name: list_packages
